scope.research_status: API/POD/source reconciliation only. No literal result, diagnostic, scalar/list-context result, or mutation has been observed or approved.

shared.outcome_channels: Probe value/return shape, object error state, warning/stderr, stdout from compatibility wrappers, mutation, and scalar/list context separately.
shared.binding_carriers: Base civil date/time/delta tuples are Perl array references, not flattened argument lists. A returned tuple is an array reference unless the operation explicitly documents a list return (for example week-year/week or all month lengths). Generic portable records represent the fields; they do not expose Perl references.

operations.purpose: Dispatch a legacy text calculation or OO calculation after operand kinds have been established.

portable_inputs.name: left
portable_inputs.type: typed date or delta; legacy route accepts text

portable_inputs.name: right
portable_inputs.type: typed date or delta; legacy route accepts text

portable_inputs.name: subtract
portable_inputs.type: omitted, false/true, or the documented approximate-calculation selector

portable_inputs.name: mode
portable_inputs.type: date/date mode: exact, semi, approx, business, bsemi, or bapprox

operations.outputs: A new Date or Delta object in OO routes; legacy routes return canonical delta/date text or empty text. Error-reference, object error, warning, and wrapper diagnostic channels require probes.

partitions.description: normal: each date/date, date/delta, and delta/delta operand pairing
normal: add and subtract selectors, including approximate selector 2
boundary: month end, leap date, DST gap/overlap, and cross-zone date/date
boundary: business schedule, weekend, holiday, and workday endpoint
invalid: unparseable legacy operands, invalid objects, unsupported operand kind, invalid arity/mode, and mixed delta modes

ambiguities: The legacy wrappers infer date versus delta from text, while OO calls use object class; identical-looking text must be probed through each profile.
The exact behavior for false, omitted, and non-boolean subtract values is not a portable claim until observed.

operations.purpose: Parse compact or localized expanded interval text into mutable Delta state.

portable_inputs.type: compact colon fields or localized expanded delta text

portable_inputs.name: functional_container
portable_inputs.type: scalar, scalar reference, or array reference where wrapper supports it

operations.outputs: OO route returns status code and mutates Delta value/input/mode/type/error state. Functional routes return canonical text or empty text and may consume token-array elements. Diagnostics and all failure channels require observation.

compact.omission: empty positions represent zero; no embedded spaces

expanded.components: optional sign, number or recognized small number word, localized field name; fields remain ordered
expanded.relative_terms: localized future/past terms may affect sign in expanded form
expanded.mode_terms: localized standard/business term may occur in text

normalization.fractional_fields: accepted text must be probed; conversion/normalization uses estimated relationships and fractional-second handling needs literal evidence

partitions.description: normal: compact one-field through seven-field forms, omitted compact positions, signs, and standard mode
normal: English expanded fields, whitespace/comma separators, future/past terms, and business marker
boundary: fractional non-second field, fractional second, mixed signs, normalization versus nonorm, and all four types
invalid: empty text, invalid compact syntax, out-of-order expanded fields, mode conflict, unsupported option/type, and type/field incompatibility
compatibility: DM5/DM6 containers, consumption, scalar/list returns, diagnostics, and DM6 deprecated parse forms

ambiguities: The finite English vocabulary and other-language vocabulary belong to language data; this catalogue records grammar classes rather than importing token tables.
The wrappers' optional conversion selector and OO parse type option are distinct mechanisms and need cross-route probes.

operations.purpose: Render one or more text patterns against a valid Delta object.
operations.outputs: One rendered text for one pattern in scalar context, ordered texts in list context, and documented empty scalar behavior for multiple patterns; invalid-object warning/undef behavior remains unobserved.

format_directives.single_field: %[+][pad][width]Xv; X is y,M,w,d,h,m,s; pad is <, >, or 0
format_directives.range_as_field: %[+][pad][width][.precision]XYZ; X is target unit and Y..Z is an inclusive ordered source range
format_directives.delta: %[+][pad][width]Dt for all fields; % [ + ] [pad] [width] DXY for inclusive ordered field range (spaces shown only as grammar separators)

partitions.description: normal: literal text, literal percent, every single field, each field range, full delta, and partial delta
boundary: positive/negative/mixed signs, width shorter/equal/longer, three padding choices, precision, and multi-pattern scalar/list context
configuration: standard/business relationship conversion and workday/workweek length
invalid: malformed/unsupported directives, reverse field range, invalid object, and warning channel

ambiguities: Unrecognized percent sequences appear to be retained by the implementation but are not frozen without probes.
Directive grammar is recorded as finite forms; output values and spacing are not copied or approved expectations.

gaps.description: All 16 operations require fresh-process DM6 and DM5 probes for values, object error state, warnings/stdout, scalar/list context, and state mutation.
DM5/DM6 DateCalc, ParseDateDelta, and Delta_Format compatibility differences need the same original cases under isolated profiles.
Arithmetic needs fixed UTC and transition-zone fixtures plus explicit business schedules, holidays, language, and reference clock before expectations can be reviewed.
Compact omission/sign/fraction grammar, localized expanded vocabulary, relative/mode terms, and malformed-input boundaries need finite case tables and observations.
Each directive family, field/range combination, precision, sign, padding, unsupported directive, multi-pattern context, and business conversion interaction needs observed output.
